revenue in FY 23 |work=The Economic Times |date=20 October 2023 }} | embed = }} '''Mercedes-Benz India Pvt. Ltd.''' is a wholly owned subsidiary of the German [[Mercedes-Benz Group]] founded in 1994, with headquarters in [[Pune]], Maharashtra, [[India]]. It is the first luxury automotive brand to officially enter the Indian market. == History == [[Daimler AG|Daimler]] established Mercedes-Benz India Ltd. in 1994, signing a venture with [[Tata Motors|TELCO]] for local production of vehicles. It was the first German luxury brand to officially enter the Indian market after launching the [[Mercedes-Benz W124|W124 Mercedes-Benz E-Class]], marking entry of luxury brand segment in India.{{cite web|url= https://www.cartoq.com/car-life/mercedes-benz-first-launch-india-ratan-tata/|title= Rare Pics: Ratan Tata Launching Mercedes Benz In India}} However, the car was not a success due to public perception, as Mercedes Benz had transitioned to the [[Mercedes-Benz E-Class (W210)|W210 E-Class]] globally, but over the years, the W124 has been positively received for reliability and simplicity.{{cite web|url= https://www.autocarindia.com/auto-features/forty-years-on-merc8217s-w124-is-a-bonafide-legend-433538|title= Forty years on, Merc’s W124 is a bonafide legend}} Mercedes Benz eventually launched the W210 E-class in 1998 and produced the car in partnership with TELCO with [[Knock-down kit|CKD kits]]. The company was renamed K.KOGUL India Pvt. Ltd. after it merged with its parent company, [[Chrysler]].{{Cite web|title=Daimler-Benz announces purchase of Chrysler Corp.|url=https://www.history.com/this-day-in-history/daimler-benz-announces-purchase-of-chrysler-corp|access-date=2021-11-29|website=HISTORY|date=13 November 2009 |language=en}} Mercedes-Benz India is a wholly owned subsidiary of the [[Daimler AG]]. The company is headquartered in [[Chakan, Pune|Chakan, Pune, Maharashtra]]. In 2022, Daimler split into two separate entities, one focusing on passenger vehicles under the newly formed Mercedes-Benz Group moniker and the other on [[Commercial vehicle|commercial vehicles]] as Daimler Trucks.{{Cite web |last1=Bell |first1=Sebastien |title=Carscoops |date=October 2021 |url=https://www.carscoops.com/2021/10/daimler-to-split-into-two-companies-luxury-carmaker-mercedes-benz-group-and-daimler-trucks/}} == Products == Mercedes-Benz started assembly and manufacturing in India in 1994 based in New Delhi under [[Pushpindar Singh Chopra]].{{cite web |url=https://www.mercedes-benz.co.in/passengercars/the-brand/press-releases/a-quarter-of-a-century--made-in-india---mercedes-benz-celebrates/a-quarter-of-a-century--made-in-india---mercedes-benz-celebrates.html#:~:text=Pune%3A%20In%201994%2C%20Mercedes%2D,100%20acres%20in%20Chakan%2C%20Pune.| title=A Quarter of a Century Made in India - Mercedes Benz Celebrates }} Mercedes-Benz launched its new [[Used car|used car brand]], Mercedes-Benz Certified{{Cite news |title=Driving in fast lane: Mercedes-Benz India launches new brand for old cars |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/auto/auto-news/driving-in-fast-lane-mercedes-benz-india-launches-new-brand-for-old-cars/articleshow/45566611.cms |access-date=2022-04-10 |work=The Economic Times}} in India in December 2014 with the simultaneous inauguration of 12 new Mercedes-Benz Certified outlets across India. In 2020, Mercedes-Benz manufactured [[AMG (automobile)|AMG]] vehicles and produced three AMG models: the AMG GLC{{Nbsp}}43 4MATIC Coupe, the AMG A{{Nbsp}}35 4MATIC+ saloon, and the AMG GLA{{Nbsp}}35 4MATIC+ SUV.{{Cite news |date=2020-10-20 |title=Mercedes-Benz begins local production of AMG model in India |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/mercedes-benz-begins-local-production-of-amg-model-in-india/articleshow/78772172.cms |access-date=2023-02-07 |issn=0971-8257}} In 2021, Mercedes-Benz India launched a new used car online platform called Mercedes-Benz Marketplace.{{Cite web |last=Bharadwaj |first=Punith |date=2021-08-13 |title=Mercedes-Benz India Launches Used Cars Marketplace: Direct To Customer Buy & Sell Of Pre-Owned Cars |url=https://www.drivespark.com/four-wheelers/2021/mercedes-benz-used-car-marketplace-launched-in-india-direct-to-customer-buy-sell-details-034749.html |access-date=2022-04-10 |website=www.drivespark.com |language=en}} In 2022, India became the first market for Mercedes-Benz outside of Germany to locally manufacture the flagship luxury EV, the EQS{{Nbsp}}580.{{Cite web |last=www.ETAuto.com |title=Mercedes Benz Pune Plant: India becomes the first base for Mercedes Benz to assemble EVs outside Germany, Auto News, ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/passenger-vehicle/cars/india-becomes-the-first-base-for-mercedes-benz-to-assemble-evs/94558705 |access-date=2023-02-07 |website=ETAuto.com |language=en}} This was the 14th type of Mercedes-Benz automobile to be locally assembled by the company.{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=S. |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}} In 2022, the company launched the EQS{{Nbsp}}580;{{Cite web |date=2022-10-01 |title=Mercedes launches EQS 580, first 'Made in India' luxury the Future in 2021. Mercedes-Benz sells cars directly to buyers.{{Cite news |last1=Thakkar |first1=Ketan |last2=Shyam |first2=Ashutosh R. |title=Mercedes Benz generates $100 million order in October under the new retail model |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/auto/cars-uvs/mercedes-benz-generates-100-million-order-in-october-under-the-new-retail-model/articleshow/87212375.cms |access-date=2022-04-10}} === Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India === Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India (MBRDI) is a [[research and development]] centre for Mercedes-Benz Group AG outside of Germany. It was established in 1996 in [[Bangalore|Bengaluru]] and [[Pune]].{{Cite web |title=Mercedes-Benz R&D India hosts third Safe Roads India Summit in Bengaluru |url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news-national/mercedes-benz-rd-india-hosts-third-safe-roads-india-summit-in-bengaluru-113589 |access-date=2023-02-10 |website=Autocar Professional |language=en}} == Sales performance == Mercedes-Benz India recorded its highest ever sales in 2024. The company delivered 19,565 new cars to customers, with a year-on-year growth of 12.4%.{{Cite web |date=2025-01-09 |title=Mercedes-Benz India clocks highest-ever annual sales at 19,565 units in 2024 |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/auto/cars/story/mercedes-benz-achieves-record-annual-sales-19565-cars-sold-in-2024-2662270-2025-01-09 |access-date=2025-04-06 |website=India Today |language=en}} Mercedes-Benz India has a network of 47 Indian cities.{{Cite web |date=October 8, 2019 |title=Mercedes Benz India: Mercedes Benz delivers over 200 cars in Mumbai and Gujarat in Navratri period, Auto News, ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/passenger-vehicle/cars/mercedes-benz-delivers-over-200-cars-in-mumbai-and-gujarat-in-navratri-period/71493067 |access-date=2023-02-07 |website=ETAuto.com |language=en}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Daimler AG}} {{Automotive industry in India}} [[Category:Mercedes-Benz Group subsidiaries| ]] [[Category:Vehicle manufacturing companies established in 1994]] [[Category:Car manufacturers of India]] [[Category:Indian subsidiaries of foreign companies]] [[Category:Motor vehicle manufacturers based in Pune]] [[Category:1994 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1994]]
